messages:
anika: kicking off canary for jade13b (int4). seeing rare OOMs on long-context summarization when prefetch is enabled. tagging infra + eng-ml.

lucas: which pool and instance class? any heap stats yet?

anika: dedicated canary pool (a100-medium). approx 1 failure per 200 requests. stack points at a big contiguous cudaMalloc in prefetch path. heap snapshot attached: 
```nheap_total=22GB; fragmentation=0.77; freelist=9; compaction_runs_last_min=0
```

mai: quick mitigations: 1) set model default max_new_tokens=96 for canary; 2) add a prefetch_size_cap_mb=1024 so prefetch won't attempt >1GB allocations; 3) enable `prefetch.streaming_first=true` so requests that would exceed cap stream instead.

ron: also lower pool frag_threshold to 0.72 so compaction runs earlier. safer than toggling prefetch off.

anika: applying changes now: `redwoodctl config set jade13b --default.max_new_tokens=96 --prefetch.size_cap_mb=1024 --prefetch.streaming_first=true` and `redwoodctl feature set --pool canary-jade --allocator.frag_threshold=0.72`

dev-bot: [alert] canary jade13b v0.9.0 failure-rate=2.4% at 6876543230. rollout paused.

anika: rollback happened. after rollback I re-ran 10k test requests with the cap+streaming_first enabled: 0 OOMs, p95 latency +12ms overall, but streaming-first increased p99 for some short prompts (because of fallback path).

lucas: acceptable trade for canary. add a metric guard: if p99_latency_increase > 100ms AND failure_rate < 0.5% for 10m, revert streaming_first to false for small prompts. we can base size on prompt_tokens < 64.

mai: created rollout rule DSL: 
```nif p99_latency_delta > 100ms AND failure_rate < 0.005 FOR 10m THEN set model.prefetch.streaming_first=false WHERE prompt_tokens < 64
```

anika: attached rule to canary-jade. also queued a QA eval to check ROUGE/F1 with max_new_tokens=96. eval-id=eval-6876543245. initial quick run shows negligible quality impact.

ron: good. propose onboarding defaults for jade13b: batch_size auto (1-2), default_max_new_tokens=96, prefetch.size_cap_mb=1024, prefetch.streaming_first=true, allocator.frag_threshold=0.72, plus the latency guard we added.

anika: will update the onboarding doc and add a stress test that triggers streaming fallback. thanks all. :rocket:

dev-bot: [info] eval queued: eval-6876543245
